name: pm51-hold-link
summary: PM51: deep standby with the DP link kept (front-end stays in its normal mode) when the main firmware marks the standby request as link-held; the PM51 wakes on video (stream width) or a new link and drops to the stock deep standby when the link is released (Option A, ~4 W instead of 12.5 W)
status: hardware-tested 2026-10-09 (DP via dock): ~4 W in hold, no wake loop or hot-plug for 3+ min, wake on video, key wake, cable pulled -> stock deep standby (section 55)

edits.asm: bank-0 free space 0xA200: hold-link standby (pre, mode, sec, poll, release; front-end queries via 0x64A4)
standby entry: mov dptr,#0x5E97 -> lcall pre (hold off)
standby entry: lcall 0x8A25 (front-end mode 3) -> lcall mode (skipped while holding the link)
sleep loop: lcall 0x880F -> lcall sec (second counter)
sleep loop: lcall 0x5BAA -> lcall poll (classifier, then the hold poll)

notes: Addresses are PM51 code addresses (bank 0, package offset 0x10080 + addr). State in XDATA 0x7F00-0x7F10. Only acts when the standby block byte +3 (XDATA 0x5E95) has bit 7 set (gate-all-dp v5, which requires this patch); otherwise stock, so it is harmless alone. Limit: the front-end decodes the stream of the routed receiver only (DP and USB-C share MSA decoder 1, measured 2026-10-09). With both DP and USB-C holding a link, video that starts on the connector that is not routed is not seen; a new link on it is still seen, and a key wakes. Generated by tools/patches_src_pm51_hold_link.py.
